text:
1693 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100 unless divisible by 400; 1693 not divisible by 4).  
Start: 1693-05-10.  
Subtract 6 months: 1692-11-10.  
Subtract 27 days: October has 31 days, so 1692-11-10 minus 10 days = 1692-10-31, minus 17 more days = 1692-10-14.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1692-10-14
